title: Piper PA-44-180 Seminole — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Piper PA-44-180 Seminole twin-engine trainer. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. The Seminole has counter-rotating propellers (left engine standard rotation, right engine opposite rotation), which eliminates the critical engine problem. Each engine has an independent fuel system with its own selector; confirm selectors are on the correct tank before every phase. Both engines have Lycoming O-360 carbureted piston engines — carburetor heat is available and should be used per the POH. Gear is retractable; know the emergency extension procedure before flight. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, manifold pressure values, and performance limits must come from the specific aircraft POH. Not a substitute for dual instruction or a multi-engine checkout with a qualified instructor.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, or other numerical limitations — all must come from the specific aircraft POH.
Equipment and avionics vary across PA-44-180 airframes. Verify every item against the specific aircraft and its POH before use.
